changes: Now a desktop app for cleaning up your inboxes. It runs on your PC from the Unified Inbox shortcut.
You stay signed in. No more reconnecting, and no Cloudflare helper needed.
While reviewing a cleanup you can read any message, send it somewhere else, or sort a whole sender at once.
“Always file sender” makes a rule from any message.
Writing mail, calendar, contacts and snooze were removed.
